"},{"span_id":"8745:1@U002","start":106,"end":258,"text":"Doors that will allow them to obtain a job position with great salary and that will give them an opportunity to do what they are most passionate about. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U003","start":258,"end":403,"text":"Just like many of these individuals, my goal is to open myself to new opportunities and experiences in order to achieve my desired career field. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U004","start":403,"end":496,"text":"Internships are a great way to get hands-on experience of one's pursuing type of employment. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U005","start":496,"end":547,"text":"However, companies do not just pick any person;

"},{"span_id":"8745:1@U006","start":547,"end":664,"text":"they must choose interns that show promising characteristics and work ethic: someone who will stand out from others. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U007","start":664,"end":786,"text":"To be en engineer is my dream job, and I would appreciate it greatly if I were to be chosen as an intern in this company. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U008","start":786,"end":914,"text":"It would be to your greatest interest to have me as an intern because I show promising results and diversity in multiple ways.
"},{"span_id":"8745:1@U009","start":914,"end":962,"text":"
I am not a stranger to the engineering field. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U010","start":962,"end":1020,"text":"I have been exposed to a series of people in this career. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U011","start":1020,"end":1110,"text":"My father is one of the best engineers at his company, and he leads several big projects. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U012","start":1110,"end":1158,"text":"He is the person I aspire to become or surpass. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U013","start":1158,"end":1222,"text":"Still, my father is not my sole relative following this career. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U014","start":1222,"end":1397,"text":"Several of my uncles have pursued this job choice, and my aunt who, even though her current job is that of a nurse, is currently studying to obtain her degree in engineering. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U015","start":1397,"end":1539,"text":"Adding to this, I am also surrounded by non-relatives who have jobs as engineers, since I live in a city with multiple engineering companies. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U016","start":1539,"end":1685,"text":"This shows that I have been exposed to engineering in several ways, which has given me an insight of what to expect while studying for the role.
"},{"span_id":"8745:1@U017","start":1685,"end":1777,"text":"
It is no secret that engineering is one of the fields that require numerous math classes. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U018","start":1777,"end":1858,"text":"Many would see this as a negative aspect of becoming an engineer; yet, I do not. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U019","start":1858,"end":1926,"text":"Mathematics have been one of my passions since I was a little girl. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U020","start":1926,"end":2015,"text":"It would fascinate me how much critical thinking and solving-problem skills it required. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U021","start":2015,"end":2054,"text":"This, of course, has not changed much. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U022","start":2054,"end":2194,"text":"Although the classes are getting more difficult as the years pass, my passion for math has not ceased; instead, one could say it has grown. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U023","start":2194,"end":2375,"text":"I am not the type of person to give up on a math problem because it is "too hard." If I am faced with a challenge, I will use all of my available sources of aid to find the answer. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U024","start":2375,"end":2457,"text":"It is this kind of dedication and hard work that has led me to where I am today.
"},{"span_id":"8745:1@U025","start":2457,"end":2593,"text":"
Diversity stands out in applications, and many companies and organizations search for those individuals that stand out from the rest. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U026","start":2593,"end":2728,"text":"There are not many women that choose engineering as their first career choice, yet I, a woman, am studying and aiming for engineering. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U027","start":2728,"end":2824,"text":"I would be the the second woman in my family to aim for this position: the first being my aunt. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U028","start":2824,"end":2935,"text":"Nevertheless, although being a woman already stands out in the engineering field, there is more of me to show. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U029","start":2935,"end":2981,"text":"For example, I am a Latina from Generic_City. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U030","start":2981,"end":3071,"text":"I lived in Generic_City up to the age of eight, which has consequently made me bilingual. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U031","start":3071,"end":3180,"text":"However, I do not only speak Spanish and English; this upcoming year, I will finish my fifth year in French. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U032","start":3180,"end":3269,"text":"Knowing multiple languages breaks many language barriers and provide more opportunities. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U033","start":3269,"end":3343,"text":"Knowing this, I decided to take part in Spanish and French Honor Society. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U034","start":3343,"end":3428,"text":"Standing out from the rest is not only an individual's goal, but also a companies'.
"},{"span_id":"8745:1@U035","start":3428,"end":3470,"text":"
The path to success in not an easy one. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U036","start":3470,"end":3519,"text":"One must submit to hours of work and dedication. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U037","start":3519,"end":3600,"text":"In this year's internship, I would be fascinated to participate in your company. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U038","start":3600,"end":3703,"text":"Since it is many students' goal to open doors for the future, I am sure there is competition involved. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U039","start":3703,"end":3784,"text":"Despite of this, I show a variety of characteristics that many would appreciate. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U040","start":3784,"end":3849,"text":"My goal is to become a successful engineer, just like my father. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U041","start":3849,"end":3970,"text":"My father, other relatives, and friends have allowed me to experience an insight into what being an engineering is like. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U042","start":3970,"end":4091,"text":"One of the things I picked up on was that there is a lot of math involved in this career; still, this is not a downfall. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U043","start":4091,"end":4166,"text":"For many years, I have been fascinated by mathematics and problem-solving. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U044","start":4166,"end":4299,"text":"The fact that math is required to be an engineer is not a complication; instead, it is an opportunity to study further what I enjoy. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U045","start":4299,"end":4426,"text":"Not only am I passionate about becoming an engineering, I also show diversity; which will make me, and the company, stand out. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U046","start":4426,"end":4528,"text":"I am the minority of female Mexican engineers, and I break the language barrier with three languages. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U047","start":4528,"end":4631,"text":"I am one out of many applicants in this internship; however, I am passionate, hardworking, and unique. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U048","start":4631,"end":4650,"text":"I am one of a kind."}],"traits":{"Cohesion":4,"Syntax":5,"Vocabulary":5,"Phraseology":4,"Grammar":4,"Conventions":5}}],"official_rubric":{"5":{"Overall":"Native-like facility in the use of language with syntactic variety, Appropriate word choice and phrases; "},{"span_id":"1440:1@U017","start":1747,"end":1789,"text":"Please dont change the time of the school."}]},{"essay_id":"8745:1","overall":5,"spans":[{"span_id":"8745:1@U001","start":0,"end":106,"text":"In many student's life, there is a set goal of succeeding in school in order to open doors in the future. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U002","start":106,"end":258,"text":"Doors that will allow them to obtain a job position with great salary and that will give them an opportunity to do what they are most passionate about. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U003","start":258,"end":403,"text":"Just like many of these individuals, my goal is to open myself to new opportunities and experiences in order to achieve my desired career field. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U004","start":403,"end":496,"text":"Internships are a great way to get hands-on experience of one's pursuing type of employment. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U005","start":496,"end":547,"text":"However, companies do not just pick any person;

"},{"span_id":"8745:1@U006","start":547,"end":664,"text":"they must choose interns that show promising characteristics and work ethic: someone who will stand out from others. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U007","start":664,"end":786,"text":"To be en engineer is my dream job, and I would appreciate it greatly if I were to be chosen as an intern in this company. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U008","start":786,"end":914,"text":"It would be to your greatest interest to have me as an intern because I show promising results and diversity in multiple ways.
"},{"span_id":"8745:1@U009","start":914,"end":962,"text":"
I am not a stranger to the engineering field. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U010","start":962,"end":1020,"text":"I have been exposed to a series of people in this career. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U011","start":1020,"end":1110,"text":"My father is one of the best engineers at his company, and he leads several big projects. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U012","start":1110,"end":1158,"text":"He is the person I aspire to become or surpass. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U013","start":1158,"end":1222,"text":"Still, my father is not my sole relative following this career. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U014","start":1222,"end":1397,"text":"Several of my uncles have pursued this job choice, and my aunt who, even though her current job is that of a nurse, is currently studying to obtain her degree in engineering. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U015","start":1397,"end":1539,"text":"Adding to this, I am also surrounded by non-relatives who have jobs as engineers, since I live in a city with multiple engineering companies. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U016","start":1539,"end":1685,"text":"This shows that I have been exposed to engineering in several ways, which has given me an insight of what to expect while studying for the role.
"},{"span_id":"8745:1@U017","start":1685,"end":1777,"text":"
It is no secret that engineering is one of the fields that require numerous math classes. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U018","start":1777,"end":1858,"text":"Many would see this as a negative aspect of becoming an engineer; yet, I do not. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U019","start":1858,"end":1926,"text":"Mathematics have been one of my passions since I was a little girl. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U020","start":1926,"end":2015,"text":"It would fascinate me how much critical thinking and solving-problem skills it required. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U021","start":2015,"end":2054,"text":"This, of course, has not changed much. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U022","start":2054,"end":2194,"text":"Although the classes are getting more difficult as the years pass, my passion for math has not ceased; instead, one could say it has grown. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U023","start":2194,"end":2375,"text":"I am not the type of person to give up on a math problem because it is "too hard." If I am faced with a challenge, I will use all of my available sources of aid to find the answer. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U024","start":2375,"end":2457,"text":"It is this kind of dedication and hard work that has led me to where I am today.
"},{"span_id":"8745:1@U025","start":2457,"end":2593,"text":"
Diversity stands out in applications, and many companies and organizations search for those individuals that stand out from the rest. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U026","start":2593,"end":2728,"text":"There are not many women that choose engineering as their first career choice, yet I, a woman, am studying and aiming for engineering. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U027","start":2728,"end":2824,"text":"I would be the the second woman in my family to aim for this position: the first being my aunt. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U028","start":2824,"end":2935,"text":"Nevertheless, although being a woman already stands out in the engineering field, there is more of me to show. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U029","start":2935,"end":2981,"text":"For example, I am a Latina from Generic_City. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U030","start":2981,"end":3071,"text":"I lived in Generic_City up to the age of eight, which has consequently made me bilingual. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U031","start":3071,"end":3180,"text":"However, I do not only speak Spanish and English; this upcoming year, I will finish my fifth year in French. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U032","start":3180,"end":3269,"text":"Knowing multiple languages breaks many language barriers and provide more opportunities. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U033","start":3269,"end":3343,"text":"Knowing this, I decided to take part in Spanish and French Honor Society. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U034","start":3343,"end":3428,"text":"Standing out from the rest is not only an individual's goal, but also a companies'.
"},{"span_id":"8745:1@U035","start":3428,"end":3470,"text":"
The path to success in not an easy one. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U036","start":3470,"end":3519,"text":"One must submit to hours of work and dedication. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U037","start":3519,"end":3600,"text":"In this year's internship, I would be fascinated to participate in your company. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U038","start":3600,"end":3703,"text":"Since it is many students' goal to open doors for the future, I am sure there is competition involved. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U039","start":3703,"end":3784,"text":"Despite of this, I show a variety of characteristics that many would appreciate. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U040","start":3784,"end":3849,"text":"My goal is to become a successful engineer, just like my father. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U041","start":3849,"end":3970,"text":"My father, other relatives, and friends have allowed me to experience an insight into what being an engineering is like. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U042","start":3970,"end":4091,"text":"One of the things I picked up on was that there is a lot of math involved in this career; still, this is not a downfall. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U043","start":4091,"end":4166,"text":"For many years, I have been fascinated by mathematics and problem-solving. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U044","start":4166,"end":4299,"text":"The fact that math is required to be an engineer is not a complication; instead, it is an opportunity to study further what I enjoy. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U045","start":4299,"end":4426,"text":"Not only am I passionate about becoming an engineering, I also show diversity; which will make me, and the company, stand out. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U046","start":4426,"end":4528,"text":"I am the minority of female Mexican engineers, and I break the language barrier with three languages. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U047","start":4528,"end":4631,"text":"I am one out of many applicants in this internship; however, I am passionate, hardworking, and unique. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U048","start":4631,"end":4650,"text":"I am one of a kind."}]}],"official_rubric":{"5":{"Overall":"Native-like facility in the use of language with syntactic variety, Appropriate word choice and phrases; Doors that will allow them to obtain a job position with great salary and that will give them an opportunity to do what they are most passionate about. Just like many of these individuals, my goal is to open myself to new opportunities and experiences in order to achieve my desired career field. Internships are a great way to get hands-on experience of one's pursuing type of employment. However, companies do not just pick any person;

they must choose interns that show promising characteristics and work ethic: someone who will stand out from others. To be en engineer is my dream job, and I would appreciate it greatly if I were to be chosen as an intern in this company. It would be to your greatest interest to have me as an intern because I show promising results and diversity in multiple ways.

I am not a stranger to the engineering field. I have been exposed to a series of people in this career. My father is one of the best engineers at his company, and he leads several big projects. He is the person I aspire to become or surpass. Still, my father is not my sole relative following this career. Several of my uncles have pursued this job choice, and my aunt who, even though her current job is that of a nurse, is currently studying to obtain her degree in engineering. Adding to this, I am also surrounded by non-relatives who have jobs as engineers, since I live in a city with multiple engineering companies. This shows that I have been exposed to engineering in several ways, which has given me an insight of what to expect while studying for the role.

It is no secret that engineering is one of the fields that require numerous math classes. Many would see this as a negative aspect of becoming an engineer; yet, I do not. Mathematics have been one of my passions since I was a little girl. It would fascinate me how much critical thinking and solving-problem skills it required. This, of course, has not changed much. Although the classes are getting more difficult as the years pass, my passion for math has not ceased; instead, one could say it has grown. I am not the type of person to give up on a math problem because it is "too hard." If I am faced with a challenge, I will use all of my available sources of aid to find the answer. It is this kind of dedication and hard work that has led me to where I am today.

Diversity stands out in applications, and many companies and organizations search for those individuals that stand out from the rest. There are not many women that choose engineering as their first career choice, yet I, a woman, am studying and aiming for engineering. I would be the the second woman in my family to aim for this position: the first being my aunt. Nevertheless, although being a woman already stands out in the engineering field, there is more of me to show. For example, I am a Latina from Generic_City. I lived in Generic_City up to the age of eight, which has consequently made me bilingual. However, I do not only speak Spanish and English; this upcoming year, I will finish my fifth year in French. Knowing multiple languages breaks many language barriers and provide more opportunities. Knowing this, I decided to take part in Spanish and French Honor Society. Standing out from the rest is not only an individual's goal, but also a companies'.

The path to success in not an easy one. One must submit to hours of work and dedication. In this year's internship, I would be fascinated to participate in your company. Since it is many students' goal to open doors for the future, I am sure there is competition involved. Despite of this, I show a variety of characteristics that many would appreciate. My goal is to become a successful engineer, just like my father. My father, other relatives, and friends have allowed me to experience an insight into what being an engineering is like. One of the things I picked up on was that there is a lot of math involved in this career; still, this is not a downfall. For many years, I have been fascinated by mathematics and problem-solving. The fact that math is required to be an engineer is not a complication; instead, it is an opportunity to study further what I enjoy. Not only am I passionate about becoming an engineering, I also show diversity; which will make me, and the company, stand out. I am the minority of female Mexican engineers, and I break the language barrier with three languages. I am one out of many applicants in this internship; however, I am passionate, hardworking, and unique. Doors that will allow them to obtain a job position with great salary and that will give them an opportunity to do what they are most passionate about. Just like many of these individuals, my goal is to open myself to new opportunities and experiences in order to achieve my desired career field. Internships are a great way to get hands-on experience of one's pursuing type of employment. However, companies do not just pick any person;

they must choose interns that show promising characteristics and work ethic: someone who will stand out from others. To be en engineer is my dream job, and I would appreciate it greatly if I were to be chosen as an intern in this company. It would be to your greatest interest to have me as an intern because I show promising results and diversity in multiple ways.

I am not a stranger to the engineering field. I have been exposed to a series of people in this career. My father is one of the best engineers at his company, and he leads several big projects. He is the person I aspire to become or surpass. Still, my father is not my sole relative following this career. Several of my uncles have pursued this job choice, and my aunt who, even though her current job is that of a nurse, is currently studying to obtain her degree in engineering. Adding to this, I am also surrounded by non-relatives who have jobs as engineers, since I live in a city with multiple engineering companies. This shows that I have been exposed to engineering in several ways, which has given me an insight of what to expect while studying for the role.

It is no secret that engineering is one of the fields that require numerous math classes. Many would see this as a negative aspect of becoming an engineer; yet, I do not. Mathematics have been one of my passions since I was a little girl. It would fascinate me how much critical thinking and solving-problem skills it required. This, of course, has not changed much. Although the classes are getting more difficult as the years pass, my passion for math has not ceased; instead, one could say it has grown. I am not the type of person to give up on a math problem because it is "too hard." If I am faced with a challenge, I will use all of my available sources of aid to find the answer. It is this kind of dedication and hard work that has led me to where I am today.

Diversity stands out in applications, and many companies and organizations search for those individuals that stand out from the rest. There are not many women that choose engineering as their first career choice, yet I, a woman, am studying and aiming for engineering. I would be the the second woman in my family to aim for this position: the first being my aunt. Nevertheless, although being a woman already stands out in the engineering field, there is more of me to show. For example, I am a Latina from Generic_City. I lived in Generic_City up to the age of eight, which has consequently made me bilingual. However, I do not only speak Spanish and English; this upcoming year, I will finish my fifth year in French. Knowing multiple languages breaks many language barriers and provide more opportunities. Knowing this, I decided to take part in Spanish and French Honor Society. Standing out from the rest is not only an individual's goal, but also a companies'.

The path to success in not an easy one. One must submit to hours of work and dedication. In this year's internship, I would be fascinated to participate in your company. Since it is many students' goal to open doors for the future, I am sure there is competition involved. Despite of this, I show a variety of characteristics that many would appreciate. My goal is to become a successful engineer, just like my father. My father, other relatives, and friends have allowed me to experience an insight into what being an engineering is like. One of the things I picked up on was that there is a lot of math involved in this career; still, this is not a downfall. For many years, I have been fascinated by mathematics and problem-solving. The fact that math is required to be an engineer is not a complication; instead, it is an opportunity to study further what I enjoy. Not only am I passionate about becoming an engineering, I also show diversity; which will make me, and the company, stand out. I am the minority of female Mexican engineers, and I break the language barrier with three languages. I am one out of many applicants in this internship; however, I am passionate, hardworking, and unique. "},{"span_id":"1683:1@U002","start":67,"end":295,"text":"People always thinking that working all the time may increase their goal, but people don't realized that working all the time is not good, you have to stop working sometimes to enjoy your day off and have fun with your friends. "},{"span_id":"1683:1@U003","start":295,"end":406,"text":"People who not working all the time are better because you may get tired and give up on what you normally do.
"},{"span_id":"1683:1@U004","start":406,"end":488,"text":"

"},{"span_id":"1683:1@U006","start":525,"end":601,"text":"For example, my friend, Generic_Name, usually a good student in the school. "},{"span_id":"1683:1@U007","start":601,"end":745,"text":"Generic_Name always finnish all of the homework, he work hard everyday to reach his goal which is making all good grade during his school year. "},{"span_id":"1683:1@U008","start":745,"end":856,"text":"When Generic_Name don't understand any work problems, he tried to ask the teacher or friends to figure it out. "},{"span_id":"1683:1@U009","start":856,"end":1137,"text":"Generic_Name keeps working hard until the last semester, he feels very tired, all of the hard work he made from the beginning of the year until the end made him a good student but he don't have any friends, Generic_Name was not hang out with any friends in school for a long time. "},{"span_id":"1683:1@U010","start":1137,"end":1259,"text":"Generic_Name used his own time to studying and the more he working hard about school work the more he losing his friends. "},{"span_id":"1683:1@U011","start":1259,"end":1679,"text":"Another example, during my freshmen year, I tried to be in a lot of clubs in school, I am one of the photographer in yearbook class, I am playing sports, and I tried to be busy as much as I can because I'm thinking that if I'm not trying to do all of the club I will not have a chance to do when I graduate, so I work very hard to went to all of the clubs meetings, sports event to take picture, keep in touch with every"},{"span_id":"1683:1@U012","start":1679,"end":1717,"text":"body in school, and makes good grade. "},{"span_id":"1683:1@U013","start":1717,"end":1891,"text":"After awhile, I was so tired I feel like I need more times to rest and have fun, so I quite playing sports and yearbook class because I feel like I don't have time for that. "},{"span_id":"1683:1@U014","start":1891,"end":2046,"text":"At the end, I realized that try to busy all the time is not good because I will get tired and want to have more time for myself to hang out with friends.
"},{"span_id":"1683:1@U015","start":2046,"end":2160,"text":"

"},{"span_id":"1683:1@U016","start":2160,"end":2264,"text":"Students, who want to become a rich person in the future, are studying the career that they don't like. "},{"span_id":"1683:1@U017","start":2264,"end":2348,"text":"In college, almost half of the students change their career during the school year. "},{"span_id":"1683:1@U018","start":2348,"end":2457,"text":"Most of the students want find the job that make a lot of money, so they choose the hardest career to study. "},{"span_id":"1683:1@U019","start":2457,"end":2532,"text":"For example, one of my friend sister was in college about three years ago. "},{"span_id":"1683:1@U020","start":2532,"end":2609,"text":"Her name is Generic_Name, she very smart and nice person, I really like her. "},{"span_id":"1683:1@U021","start":2609,"end":2664,"text":"Generic_Name told me that she want to become a lawyer. "},{"span_id":"1683:1@U022","start":2664,"end":2778,"text":"At first, I was shot because I knew that she don't like anything about laws and I though she just joking with me. "},{"span_id":"1683:1@U023","start":2778,"end":2895,"text":"After Generic_Name graduate from high school she went to college and studying all of the courses to become a lawyer. "},{"span_id":"1683:1@U024","start":2895,"end":3064,"text":"I went to Generic_Name house last Sunday and hang out with her, she told me that she changed her career to become a high school math teacher because she likes that job. "},{"span_id":"1683:1@U025","start":3064,"end":3462,"text":"Generic_Name told me that studying about laws was a lot of work for her, she had to stay up late to studying the laws, she had to work harder than other people to because she don't know much about laws, sometimes she just want to give up, so she made her decision to become a math teacher, it is not a great idea at first but it is a good experience to learn about other career, Generic_Name said. "},{"span_id":"1683:1@U026","start":3462,"end":3528,"text":"Another example, I played basketball when I was in middle school. "},{"span_id":"1683:1@U027","start":3528,"end":3601,"text":"I'm not good at it but I tried hard to be a part of the basketball team. "},{"span_id":"1683:1@U028","start":3601,"end":3758,"text":"I went to the camp, the park, and I played everywhere I could but when I made in the basketball team feel like there are not the place I want to practicing. "},{"span_id":"1683:1@U029","start":3758,"end":3811,"text":"I want to have fun not just worry about win or lose. "},{"span_id":"1683:1@U030","start":3811,"end":4190,"text":"During practice, it is not fun at all, I have to remember the plays, and have to know what going on during the game, so I started to give up, but I'm glad to be one of the member on the team.Do stuffs all the time will help you work much faster and better, but if you are not have fun and make yourself work harder you may not receive the goal that you want from the beginning.
"},{"span_id":"1683:1@U031","start":4190,"end":4289,"text":"

"},{"span_id":"1683:1@U032","start":4289,"end":4352,"text":"It is wonderful how much may be done if they are always doing. "},{"span_id":"1683:1@U033","start":4352,"end":4579,"text":"Keep up with your work and work hard may improve your skills, the more you are work the more you get better, but if you keep working hard all the the time you may get tired, need some rest, and give up on what you normally do. "},{"span_id":"1683:1@U034","start":4579,"end":4719,"text":"Sometime to be inactivity is better, you don't have to worry about your goal and you don't have to work hard every days to reach your goal. "},{"span_id":"1683:1@U035","start":4719,"end":4805,"text":"Working all the time is not good for you, it made you feel tired and want to give up. "},{"span_id":"1683:1@U036","start":4805,"end":4902,"text":"Staying happy all the time and have fun to hang out with your friends will make you feel better. "},{"span_id":"1683:1@U037","start":4902,"end":4991,"text":"Don't work to hard there are more things that you never seen are waiting for you to try. "},{"span_id":"5440:1@U020","start":1960,"end":2025,"text":"For this reason, people should have goals and aim high not low.
"},{"span_id":"5440:1@U021","start":2025,"end":2175,"text":"

"},{"span_id":"5440:1@U025","start":2492,"end":2555,"text":"The surgery went very well, and the patient went home healthy. "},{"span_id":"5440:1@U026","start":2555,"end":2683,"text":"The main character in this TV show didn't believe that he could do the surgery, and when he had to do the surgery it went well. "},{"span_id":"5440:1@U027","start":2683,"end":2779,"text":"Likewise, people should aim high and believe in themselves more to achieve what they aimed for. "},{"span_id":"2801:2@U002","start":60,"end":208,"text":"Most people might say it's made a positive impact on people's lives while others may disagree and say it's had a negative impact on people's lives. "},{"span_id":"2801:2@U003","start":208,"end":277,"text":"There may be some pros and there may be some cons to this situation. "},{"span_id":"2801:2@U004","start":277,"end":333,"text":"Can the impact of technology be a good or bad outcome?
"},{"span_id":"2801:2@U005","start":333,"end":474,"text":"
Let's start off with the pros or the positive effects technology has had on people's lives, now technology has made people's lives easier. "},{"span_id":"2801:2@U006","start":474,"end":580,"text":"Some may say because it's easier to access what they need easier online instead of heading to the market. "},{"span_id":"2801:2@U007","start":580,"end":735,"text":"Some may also say it's easier and faster to call your friends or parents, any family member really, instead of driving all the way to them, which is true. "},{"span_id":"2801:2@U008","start":735,"end":875,"text":"Watching movies on your phone instead of going all the way to the movie theater and pay for your ticket and it only being a one time thing. "},{"span_id":"2801:2@U009","start":875,"end":962,"text":"There are countless positives outcomes of how technology has increased over the years. "},{"span_id":"2801:2@U010","start":962,"end":1040,"text":"The technology nowadays makes everything faster and easier on people's lives. "},{"span_id":"2801:2@U011","start":1040,"end":1132,"text":"Unfortunately, all these great, glamorous, fast, and easy ways have some downfall to them.
"},{"span_id":"2801:2@U012","start":1132,"end":1216,"text":"
Now, technology definitely has it's flaws and negative impacts on people's lives. "},{"span_id":"2801:2@U013","start":1216,"end":1315,"text":"Most can say there's not as much human interactions since technology has been brought upon people. "},{"span_id":"2801:2@U014","start":1315,"end":1371,"text":"Communication is key when interacting with one another. "},{"span_id":"2801:2@U015","start":1371,"end":1468,"text":"Today most people are also glued to their cellular device, not physically but you get the point. "},{"span_id":"2801:2@U016","start":1468,"end":1559,"text":"Especially teenagers, they have a bad habit of not being able to put down their cellphone. "},{"span_id":"2801:2@U017","start":1559,"end":1670,"text":"Whether that being during school hours, at home when you're supposed to be doing work, and maybe even at work. "},{"span_id":"2801:2@U018","start":1670,"end":1785,"text":"The generation we have today is usually all about social media, and just being on their cellphone in general 24/7. "},{"span_id":"2801:2@U019","start":1785,"end":1873,"text":"Point blank there's just no physical, verbal communication anymore between one another. "},{"span_id":"2801:2@U020","start":1873,"end":2010,"text":"It may be causing a lot of students to slack in school, and it may not only go for students and teenagers, they're not the only victims. "},{"span_id":"2801:2@U021","start":2010,"end":2090,"text":"Some particular parents may be also glued to their cellphone just as teenagers. "},{"span_id":"2801:2@U022","start":2090,"end":2156,"text":"It's not their fault nor do the teenagers have any fault in this. "},{"span_id":"2801:2@U023","start":2156,"end":2208,"text":"All this is because of the evolution of technology. "},{"span_id":"2801:2@U024","start":2208,"end":2421,"text":"It's not pleasant to live in a world with not so much communication and everyone being constantly glued to their cellphone nor is it pleasant to do awful in school because you can't put your cellular device down. "},{"span_id":"2801:2@U025","start":2421,"end":2523,"text":"Now, these are just some reasons and examples why technology has a negative impact on people's lives. "},{"span_id":"2801:2@U026","start":2523,"end":2588,"text":"Can you imagine how many more scenarios like this happen daily?
"},{"span_id":"2801:2@U027","start":2588,"end":2757,"text":"
Though technology has evolved drastically through out the years and is still evolving now as we speak, there's always going going to be positive and negative impacts. "},{"span_id":"2801:2@U028","start":2757,"end":2849,"text":"Technology does help and allow people to complete tasks without having contact with others. "},{"span_id":"2801:2@U029","start":2849,"end":2908,"text":"There's the problem right there, there's no communication. "},{"span_id":"2801:2@U030","start":2908,"end":3047,"text":"Even though there are some positive effects of technology that doesn't change the fact that there are more negative effects than positive. "},{"span_id":"2801:2@U031","start":3047,"end":3173,"text":"Technology effects each person a different way, whether that being in a positive way or whether that being in a negative way. "},{"span_id":"2801:2@U032","start":3173,"end":3269,"text":"It's all a mix, and by mix I refer to positive effects and negative effects all over the place. "},{"span_id":"2801:2@U033","start":3269,"end":3353,"text":"Some people may disagree or may agree whether it's a bad mixture or a good mixture. "},{"span_id":"2801:2@U034","start":3353,"end":3434,"text":"Cell phones and all technology can make it easier or harder for certain people.
"},{"span_id":"2801:2@U035","start":3434,"end":3558,"text":"
Whether if it truly is a positive or negative impact it will not change what people think or at what position they're in. "},{"span_id":"2801:2@U036","start":3558,"end":3678,"text":"Some people just like taking the easy way out and not cope with what they are losing and missing out on, communication. "},{"span_id":"2853:2@U028","start":3955,"end":4028,"text":"you are in college do your best and do your work and life the live chill."}]},"history":[{"essay_id":"459:1","overall":3,"spans":[{"span_id":"459:1@U001","start":0,"end":73,"text":"Should your school follow this model by extending the school day hours?
"},{"span_id":"459:1@U002","start":73,"end":209,"text":"
There are some people would love to have a two hour extended school day and theres some that don't want two hour extended school day. "},{"span_id":"459:1@U003","start":209,"end":261,"text":"Therefore, schools shouldn't extend two more hours. "},{"span_id":"459:1@U004","start":261,"end":320,"text":"There some students that have jobs or have to take care

"},{"span_id":"459:1@U005","start":320,"end":339,"text":"of there siblings. "},{"span_id":"459:1@U006","start":339,"end":466,"text":"The schools can add an two more hours for the people that need it for extra help or for the ones that want to graduate early.
"},{"span_id":"459:1@U007","start":466,"end":517,"text":"
Schools should not be extending it by two hours. "},{"span_id":"459:1@U008","start":517,"end":624,"text":"The students will make an issue if they have two hour extended and they make end up being late for school. "},{"span_id":"459:1@U009","start":624,"end":844,"text":"What the schools should do is to get the people that wants to have a two hour extended time for school for any type of reason and give it to them or give it to the students that are struggling in a class and extra help. "},{"span_id":"459:1@U010","start":844,"end":952,"text":"It will make a big change if the schools do it like that even for the students that want to graduate early. "},{"span_id":"459:1@U011","start":952,"end":1049,"text":"The students will not really stressed about it but the idea is to make it easy for the students. "},{"span_id":"459:1@U012","start":1049,"end":1112,"text":"however, the schools can go different ways with this extents.
"},{"span_id":"459:1@U013","start":1112,"end":1236,"text":"
The disadvantage is how the school schedule is changing maybe less sleep for the students or more sleep for the students. "},{"span_id":"459:1@U014","start":1236,"end":1332,"text":"Since the school are extending two more hours they can leave the schedule how it or change it.
"},{"span_id":"459:1@U015","start":1332,"end":1475,"text":"
The problem with that the students will get more confused on there school schedule and the time that they have to leave to there next class. "},{"span_id":"459:1@U016","start":1475,"end":1651,"text":"The four day week for school might work for studnets but they will miss a lot of learning and all that important stuff also they can relax and not be over stress about school. "},{"span_id":"459:1@U017","start":1651,"end":1695,"text":"The four day week of school sounds about

"},{"span_id":"459:1@U018","start":1695,"end":1828,"text":"right but adding two more hours into school is going to be a little issue however, the studnets have too do a lot of work in school. "}]},{"essay_id":"2773:2","overall":4,"spans":[{"span_id":"2773:2@U001","start":0,"end":9,"text":"Dear,

"},{"span_id":"2773:2@U002","start":9,"end":38,"text":"School Board of Education

"},{"span_id":"2773:2@U003","start":38,"end":116,"text":"I personally disagree with the idea of adding one and a half hours of school. "},{"span_id":"2773:2@U004","start":116,"end":244,"text":"This is a terrible Idea and here are some reasons why I disagree so please grab a seat, relax, and take your time to read this. "},{"span_id":"2773:2@U005","start":244,"end":346,"text":"The first reason why there shouldn't be extra school hours is students will have to walk in the dark. "},{"span_id":"2773:2@U006","start":346,"end":484,"text":"The second reason is students will have less time for sports and other after school activities and also less time for family and friends. "},{"span_id":"2773:2@U007","start":484,"end":604,"text":"And finally students will be sick of having school for a such a long period of time and possibly stop going to school.
"},{"span_id":"2773:2@U008","start":604,"end":838,"text":"
First of all not everyone is fortunate enough to have a ride to school but that doesen't mean that they can't go to school so they walk, but if the school board adds more school time students who walk will have to walk in the dark. "},{"span_id":"2773:2@U009","start":838,"end":1068,"text":"Walking in the dark could be very dangerous because you don't know whats in front nor what's behind you and that could cause students not to go to school anymore because they will be scared of walking in the dark and feel unsafe. "},{"span_id":"2773:2@U010","start":1068,"end":1289,"text":"Another example of why it could be dangerous to walk in the dark is if someone is trying to cross the street and a car doesen't see them they'll probably get ran over and the school won't be responsible for the accident. "},{"span_id":"2773:2@U011","start":1289,"end":1452,"text":"Something that also is good to keep in mind is that if the school hours get changed and even if you try to avoid students from walking in the dark There's a cost. "},{"span_id":"2773:2@U012","start":1452,"end":1574,"text":"You'll have to put street lights and that could be very expensive, and the money could be used for educational purposes.
"},{"span_id":"2773:2@U013","start":1574,"end":1714,"text":"
The second reason why extra school hours shouldn't be added is students won't have much time for sports or other after school activities. "},{"span_id":"2773:2@U014","start":1714,"end":1793,"text":"Sports and school are both important and they both should be equally balanced. "},{"span_id":"2773:2@U015","start":1793,"end":1881,"text":"So if school gets longer than maybe we'll have less time to see our family and friends. "},{"span_id":"2773:2@U016","start":1881,"end":2179,"text":"I remember when I did football practice was getting shorter and shorter because winter came, and during that time it was also raining a lot and snowing a lot so we missed a lot of games and practices, imagine if school was an hour and a half long, there wouldn't even be a football season at all.
"},{"span_id":"2773:2@U017","start":2179,"end":2392,"text":"
The last reason why an extra hour and a half of school is a bad idea is because, a lot of students would get really sick of school and stay home or try to get suspended so that they don't have to got to school. "},{"span_id":"2773:2@U018","start":2392,"end":2605,"text":"We've all been in that situation where we don't want to go to school so we pretend we're sick, even I get tired of having to go to school every day, in fact I don't really want to be here right now but I have to. "},{"span_id":"2773:2@U019","start":2605,"end":2751,"text":"We've all tried to make our parents believe that we're sick, but that's a really old trick and parents already know it, and make us go to school. "},{"span_id":"2773:2@U020","start":2751,"end":2844,"text":"If students get more school time they just won't stand it and they'll start skipping school. "},{"span_id":"2773:2@U021","start":2844,"end":2878,"text":"But don't worry I won't do that.
"},{"span_id":"2773:2@U022","start":2878,"end":3146,"text":"
In conclusion I think adding an extra hour and a half of school is a horrific idea, it will just cause more problems for the education system, students, parents, and even for our hard working teachers because they will have a more work and less time for themselves. "},{"span_id":"2773:2@U023","start":3146,"end":3218,"text":"But I also understand why you would want to add an extra hour of school."}]},{"essay_id":"2859:2","overall":3,"spans":[{"span_id":"2859:2@U001","start":0,"end":59,"text":"Throughout, the years technology has been getting smarter. "},{"span_id":"2859:2@U002","start":59,"end":120,"text":"A long time ago people didnt have technology like we do now. "},{"span_id":"2859:2@U003","start":120,"end":182,"text":"Being able to do things online for some people is way easier. "},{"span_id":"2859:2@U004","start":182,"end":273,"text":"Sometimes the people are busy and don't have time to go places or don't like going places. "},{"span_id":"2859:2@U013","start":811,"end":914,"text":"Some people would argue that it is good to do stuff on your own, but I think i'd rather do it online.
"},{"span_id":"2859:2@U014","start":914,"end":966,"text":"
Some people are really good at talking to others. "},{"span_id":"2859:2@U015","start":966,"end":1040,"text":"I know many people who are anti-social, they dthe dont like talking much. "},{"span_id":"2859:2@U016","start":1040,"end":1121,"text":"when people meet me for the first time they always ask why I dont talk to muuch. "},{"span_id":"2859:2@U017","start":1121,"end":1182,"text":"I always respond with the same answer "i dont like people" . "},{"span_id":"2859:2@U018","start":1182,"end":1248,"text":"The technology hepls people because it has so many new features . "},{"span_id":"2859:2@U019","start":1248,"end":1291,"text":"Like you can practicly do anything online. "},{"span_id":"2859:2@U020","start":1291,"end":1338,"text":"it is such a big help for people who need it.
"},{"span_id":"2859:2@U021","start":1338,"end":1410,"text":"
In my opinion i think it is smart that we can now do anything online. "},{"span_id":"2859:2@U022","start":1410,"end":1473,"text":"I really dont like talking to people.They make me so nervous . "},{"span_id":"2859:2@U023","start":1473,"end":1542,"text":"When i get nervous i turn really red, i start to talk really fast

"},{"span_id":"2859:2@U024","start":1542,"end":1576,"text":", and my hands get really shakey. "},{"span_id":"2859:2@U025","start":1576,"end":1806,"text":"My friends tell me i need to talk to more people if i want to help myself out , but i always say no .I would like to take online school or be homeschooled because going to public schools have to many people go to public schools.
"},{"span_id":"2859:2@U026","start":1806,"end":1985,"text":"

"},{"span_id":"8323:2@U011","start":1445,"end":1542,"text":"Other students have jobs, and have the same schedule at the same time as the two hours extended. "},{"span_id":"8323:2@U012","start":1542,"end":1660,"text":"Other students practice sports, but they cannot go to their practices, because the same reason of two hours exteded.
"},{"span_id":"8323:2@U013","start":1660,"end":1884,"text":"
Last disadvantage, if school extends two hours the school day, is that students will be more tired, if they study two hours more, plus the students who have a job, and work after school, those students will be more tired. "},{"span_id":"8323:2@U014","start":1884,"end":2048,"text":"Students will not be focusing in classes, and will have more homework, and more work to do in class, because they have extra hours that they probably did not want. "},{"span_id":"8323:2@U015","start":2048,"end":2128,"text":"Some students would be stressed out, because some might not like the new model. "},{"span_id":"8323:2@U016","start":2128,"end":2248,"text":"Some students will not be able to stay in school two more hours, because of personal things, or tasks they need to do.
"},{"span_id":"8323:2@U017","start":2248,"end":2582,"text":"
In conclusion, if the school follows this new model of four-day school week, which extends two hours, making ten hours per school day, students cannot stay longer, because some go to work, religion things that they need to do, or even they practice some sport after school, but not at school, and they cannot go to their practices. "},{"span_id":"7798:1@U009","start":1385,"end":1414,"text":"thats where i want to and do."}]},{"essay_id":"7766:2","overall":4,"spans":[{"span_id":"7766:2@U001","start":0,"end":209,"text":"Schools do their best to provide best education for all the students.They have various types of summer projects, classes, programs, education tours, online courses and more, that a student can participate on. "},{"span_id":"7766:2@U002","start":209,"end":273,"text":"Some schools even have internships that students get paid from. "},{"span_id":"7766:2@U003","start":273,"end":376,"text":"Some schools assign students their projects to assure, that they continue learning during their break. "},{"span_id":"7766:2@U004","start":376,"end":500,"text":"Most students fail to continue to learn because they have their own personal plans to accomplish during their summer break. "},{"span_id":"7766:2@U005","start":500,"end":666,"text":"But, some students fail to do it because the projects were given from their previous teacher, that they have already had and they do not want to work for them again. "},{"span_id":"7766:2@U006","start":666,"end":736,"text":"They would be more happier to design their own project for the break. "},{"span_id":"7766:2@U007","start":736,"end":852,"text":"The fact that they want to choose their own project is because they want to be more productive and more innovative. "},{"span_id":"7766:2@U008","start":852,"end":907,"text":"Although, summer projects should be student-designed.
"},{"span_id":"7766:2@U009","start":907,"end":1104,"text":"
Some people might claim that, projects should be school-based and it should be assigned by the teachers because they have the best opinions for the student to work on and they are more relevant. "},{"span_id":"7766:2@U010","start":1104,"end":1257,"text":"Teachers can evaluate students' weaknesses and give them projects based on what they need, for their own practice and revision session during the break. "},{"span_id":"7766:2@U011","start":1257,"end":1388,"text":"Teachers should assign project about the course, that they have already completed for more revision and for more details about it. "},{"span_id":"7766:2@U012","start":1388,"end":1712,"text":"For example, i already completed the earth science course on my freshmen year but, for more details and information about the topic that we discussed, our teacher gave us the project about the climate change and the impact on the environment, during the summer time, so that we can be productive and visualize in our break. "},{"span_id":"7766:2@U013","start":1712,"end":1835,"text":"Teacher-designed projects are more reliable because the teacher can choose a specific topic for the students' requirement. "},{"span_id":"7766:2@U014","start":1835,"end":1922,"text":"Some students are naive, they can't come up with a topic and they end up not doing it. "},{"span_id":"7766:2@U015","start":1922,"end":2142,"text":"Of course, many students will probably disagree on student-designed projects, and claim that teacher-designed topics are way better. However, every person has an interest on doing something or every person have a hobby. "},{"span_id":"7766:2@U016","start":2142,"end":2291,"text":"Moreover, students should be able to decide on what they desire to work on from their own interest or describe about their hobby, writing an essay.
"},{"span_id":"7766:2@U017","start":2291,"end":2385,"text":"
Students should be self-reliance of themselves because self-reliance is the key to success. "},{"span_id":"7766:2@U018","start":2385,"end":2516,"text":"They should not depend on anyone else, but their heart and the way how they think, that will bring accomplishments to their lives. "},{"span_id":"7766:2@U019","start":2516,"end":2767,"text":"I understand that teachers are responsible of giving the best topics for students to work on, but i believe that, students have followed all the directions of the teacher, during the entire school-year, but in a long break, it should be the opposite. "},{"span_id":"7766:2@U020","start":2767,"end":2898,"text":"Teachers should allow students to think of their own and come up with a topic ,and write what they have learned from the teachers. "},{"span_id":"7766:2@U021","start":2898,"end":3003,"text":"Student-designed projects will help them research about topics and, it will benefit them for the future. "},{"span_id":"7766:2@U022","start":3003,"end":3042,"text":"It will help them think independently. "},{"span_id":"7766:2@U023","start":3042,"end":3119,"text":"It will allow them to choose their desired topic and work on their own will. "},{"span_id":"7766:2@U024","start":3119,"end":3252,"text":"For example, my oceanography teacher allowed us to pick a topic from the board and he gave us an option to choose our own topic too. "},{"span_id":"7766:2@U025","start":3252,"end":3578,"text":"I managed to pick a topic that i desired, eventually, i completed my project researching and thinking about the topic on my own because i was able to elaborate it myself, since i got to choose the desired topic i want, but some of my classmates had a hard time by only researching because they chose the topic from the board. "},{"span_id":"7766:2@U026","start":3578,"end":3690,"text":"Furthermore, students can observe from their teacher and get to the point, when they can think for themselves.
"},{"span_id":"7766:2@U027","start":3690,"end":3754,"text":"
It is evidenced that, you can learn a lot from visualization. "},{"span_id":"7766:2@U028","start":3754,"end":3947,"text":"Most of the students go to trips, during summer time with their family ,and that will be great advantage for a student to come up with a self-designed project, as they visualize on their trip. "},{"span_id":"7766:2@U029","start":3947,"end":4032,"text":"For example, when you go to the museum, there is lot to visualize and learn from it. "},{"span_id":"7766:2@U030","start":4032,"end":4156,"text":"Self-designed projects would be complicated for some students, but most importantly, research and your effort, is required. "},{"span_id":"7766:2@U031","start":4156,"end":4273,"text":"As evidenced by the quote, "as you sow, so you reap", it means the harder you work, the better your results will be. "},{"span_id":"7766:2@U032","start":4273,"end":4325,"text":"We should always remember that, effort is valuable. "},{"span_id":"7766:2@U033","start":4325,"end":4427,"text":"Self-designed projects are very beneficial because it helps you to work as an independent individual. "},{"span_id":"7766:2@U034","start":4427,"end":4508,"text":"Furthermore, you will gain the way how you think, both physically and mentally.
"},{"span_id":"7766:2@U035","start":4508,"end":4626,"text":"
In conclusion, teachers should allow students, to think for themselves' ,and allow students to choose their topics. "},{"span_id":"7766:2@U036","start":4626,"end":4698,"text":"Students-designed projects will help them think more efficiently and

"},{"span_id":"7766:2@U037","start":4698,"end":4755,"text":"it is more convenient for both students and the teacher. "},{"span_id":"7766:2@U038","start":4755,"end":4833,"text":"Visualization would be an easy hint for the student to work on their project. "},{"span_id":"7766:2@U039","start":4833,"end":4965,"text":"For the solution, teachers should assign students to write a journal about, how they spent their time during the long summer break. "},{"span_id":"7766:2@U040","start":4965,"end":5044,"text":"Potentially, this will make it very easier for both students and the teachers. "},{"span_id":"7766:2@U041","start":5044,"end":5198,"text":"This will allow student to write about their real-life event ,and it will make the teacher very happy about reading student's personal summer experience. "}]}],"official_rubric":{"5":{"Overall":"Native-like facility in the use of language with syntactic variety, Appropriate word choice and phrases; "},{"span_id":"8722:1@U002","start":19,"end":120,"text":"If our school were to change the cafeteria food to healthier food selections it would be a bad idea. "},{"span_id":"8722:1@U003","start":120,"end":314,"text":"This decision would be a bad idea because some students do not eat lunch as it is, other students say that the cafeteria food is already healthy, others would leave campus or order food online. "},{"span_id":"8722:1@U004","start":314,"end":449,"text":"Some schools in other school districts have changed their school menu and many students and parents do not like it nor agree with it.
"},{"span_id":"8722:1@U005","start":449,"end":523,"text":"
Students do not eat lunch now a days because they do not like the food. "},{"span_id":"8722:1@U006","start":523,"end":672,"text":"Some rather just go to the snack bar or vending machine we have in the cafeteria and eat snacks rather than food or bring their own lunch to school. "},{"span_id":"8722:1@U007","start":672,"end":824,"text":"Students bring their own food most of the time because they are used to different foods or they are allergic to certain types of foods or ingredients.
"},{"span_id":"8722:1@U008","start":824,"end":885,"text":"
Others may say that the cafeteria food is already healthy. "},{"span_id":"8722:1@U009","start":885,"end":954,"text":"In the cafeteria there are many options in the four different lines. "},{"span_id":"8722:1@U010","start":954,"end":1055,"text":"For example one line can have three main foods with different sides including fruits and vegetables. "},{"span_id":"8722:1@U011","start":1055,"end":1156,"text":"The school line also has an option between the three main foods they are serving or a salad or wrap. "},{"span_id":"8722:1@U012","start":1156,"end":1288,"text":"When the school cafeteria serves bread or any type of carbs it usually is always wheat bread which is better than any other bread.
"},{"span_id":"8722:1@U013","start":1288,"end":1387,"text":"
Students who have cars or credit cards often leave school to get food or they order food online. "},{"span_id":"8722:1@U014","start":1387,"end":1567,"text":"Upperclassmen, juniors and seniors are often the ones who leave campus to get food because they have there license and have cars or they also have friends who have transportation. "},{"span_id":"8722:1@U015","start":1567,"end":1682,"text":"They usually do not come back for their last periods of the day or if they come back they come back late to class. "},{"span_id":"8722:1@U016","start":1682,"end":1786,"text":"Now with new technology and apps students order food through apps that deliver any type of food to you. "},{"span_id":"8722:1@U017","start":1786,"end":1864,"text":"Students often get in trouble by teachers and staff for it but do it anyway.
"},{"span_id":"8722:1@U018","start":1864,"end":1996,"text":"
In conclusion these are some of the reasons why changing the school cafeteria lunch/menu to a healthier menu would be a bad idea. "},{"span_id":"8722:1@U019","start":1996,"end":2121,"text":"Students who do not like the school lunches already do not eat, they would leave campus and not come back or come back late. "},{"span_id":"8404:1@U002","start":137,"end":176,"text":"If you think about it he is not wrong. "},{"span_id":"8404:1@U003","start":176,"end":215,"text":"You would want new challenges in life. "},{"span_id":"8404:1@U004","start":215,"end":338,"text":"Also if you mastered something you do on a everyday task it will start to get boring so you'll want to try something new.
"},{"span_id":"8404:1@U005","start":338,"end":376,"text":"
For example I'm a master at makeup. "},{"span_id":"8404:1@U006","start":376,"end":481,"text":"Since I do makeup everyday, I like to challenge myself once in a while to do something new with my face. "},{"span_id":"8404:1@U007","start":481,"end":562,"text":"Another thing is I would volunteer at festivals to draw designs on people faces. "},{"span_id":"8404:1@U008","start":562,"end":625,"text":"I also get called to do peoples makeup for a special occasion. "},{"span_id":"8404:1@U009","start":625,"end":746,"text":"These are my example for why people should try something challenging in their life once they become a pro at something.
"},{"span_id":"8404:1@U010","start":746,"end":870,"text":"

"},{"span_id":"8404:1@U011","start":870,"end":995,"text":"Another example is like in High school, you take different classes every new year to learn more and more about the subjects. "},{"span_id":"8404:1@U012","start":995,"end":1116,"text":"Once you've mastered it you can go to the next level witch is going to be challenging but that's how you grow and learn. "},{"span_id":"8404:1@U013","start":1116,"end":1191,"text":"Say if you repeat the same class you will become a master at that subject. "},{"span_id":"8404:1@U014","start":1191,"end":1271,"text":"So don't be scared to take beyond challenges because your growing as a person.
"},{"span_id":"8404:1@U015","start":1271,"end":1347,"text":"

"},{"span_id":"8404:1@U017","start":1379,"end":1495,"text":"Even if you're a master at doing something that you love doing, kick it up a little and challenge yourself to grow. "},{"span_id":"8404:1@U018","start":1495,"end":1567,"text":"It wouldn't hurt to try something new to develop your brain and skills. "},{"span_id":"8404:1@U019","start":1567,"end":1665,"text":"That's why I take the challenges on going to festivals and doing peoples makeup for five dollars. "},{"span_id":"8404:1@U020","start":1665,"end":1763,"text":"Sometimes i would be scared to mess up, but its okay because I'm working on developing my skills. "},{"span_id":"2773:2@U002","start":9,"end":38,"text":"School Board of Education

"},{"span_id":"2773:2@U003","start":38,"end":116,"text":"I personally disagree with the idea of adding one and a half hours of school. "},{"span_id":"2773:2@U004","start":116,"end":244,"text":"This is a terrible Idea and here are some reasons why I disagree so please grab a seat, relax, and take your time to read this. "},{"span_id":"2773:2@U005","start":244,"end":346,"text":"The first reason why there shouldn't be extra school hours is students will have to walk in the dark. "},{"span_id":"2773:2@U006","start":346,"end":484,"text":"The second reason is students will have less time for sports and other after school activities and also less time for family and friends. "},{"span_id":"2773:2@U007","start":484,"end":604,"text":"And finally students will be sick of having school for a such a long period of time and possibly stop going to school.
"},{"span_id":"2773:2@U008","start":604,"end":838,"text":"

"},{"span_id":"2773:2@U009","start":838,"end":1068,"text":"Walking in the dark could be very dangerous because you don't know whats in front nor what's behind you and that could cause students not to go to school anymore because they will be scared of walking in the dark and feel unsafe. "},{"span_id":"2773:2@U010","start":1068,"end":1289,"text":"Another example of why it could be dangerous to walk in the dark is if someone is trying to cross the street and a car doesen't see them they'll probably get ran over and the school won't be responsible for the accident. "},{"span_id":"2773:2@U011","start":1289,"end":1452,"text":"Something that also is good to keep in mind is that if the school hours get changed and even if you try to avoid students from walking in the dark There's a cost. "},{"span_id":"2773:2@U012","start":1452,"end":1574,"text":"You'll have to put street lights and that could be very expensive, and the money could be used for educational purposes.
"},{"span_id":"2773:2@U013","start":1574,"end":1714,"text":"
The second reason why extra school hours shouldn't be added is students won't have much time for sports or other after school activities. "},{"span_id":"2773:2@U014","start":1714,"end":1793,"text":"Sports and school are both important and they both should be equally balanced. "},{"span_id":"2773:2@U015","start":1793,"end":1881,"text":"So if school gets longer than maybe we'll have less time to see our family and friends. "},{"span_id":"2773:2@U016","start":1881,"end":2179,"text":"I remember when I did football practice was getting shorter and shorter because winter came, and during that time it was also raining a lot and snowing a lot so we missed a lot of games and practices, imagine if school was an hour and a half long, there wouldn't even be a football season at all.
"},{"span_id":"2773:2@U017","start":2179,"end":2392,"text":"

"},{"span_id":"2773:2@U018","start":2392,"end":2605,"text":"We've all been in that situation where we don't want to go to school so we pretend we're sick, even I get tired of having to go to school every day, in fact I don't really want to be here right now but I have to. "},{"span_id":"2773:2@U019","start":2605,"end":2751,"text":"We've all tried to make our parents believe that we're sick, but that's a really old trick and parents already know it, and make us go to school. "},{"span_id":"2773:2@U020","start":2751,"end":2844,"text":"If students get more school time they just won't stand it and they'll start skipping school. "},{"span_id":"2773:2@U021","start":2844,"end":2878,"text":"But don't worry I won't do that.
"},{"span_id":"2773:2@U022","start":2878,"end":3146,"text":"

"},{"span_id":"585:1@U002","start":140,"end":323,"text":"Parents would disagree with the thought of having their kids staying home and learning but I believe that students should have distance learning as an option and let me tell you why. "},{"span_id":"585:1@U003","start":323,"end":478,"text":"Every student learns at a different pace, students often debate on showing up or staying home from school, and not all students require the same classes.
"},{"span_id":"585:1@U004","start":478,"end":624,"text":"
First reason why i believe distance learning is beneficial and should be offer at schools is because not every student learns at the same pace. "},{"span_id":"585:1@U005","start":624,"end":713,"text":"Some students would require a little more time on an assignment as the others would not. "},{"span_id":"585:1@U006","start":713,"end":906,"text":"I grew up in a community where teachers didn't ask if you'd understood the lesson, or if you needed help, they would just keeping moving forward, which had a huge negative impact in my grades. "},{"span_id":"585:1@U007","start":906,"end":1164,"text":"Having one on one lessons with teachers and getting the proper education without actually being there, but through a computer screen on the other side of the state is a game changing experience that students would love and should be willing to choose from.
"},{"span_id":"585:1@U008","start":1164,"end":1376,"text":"
Second reason why i think online or video conferencing is beneficial to students is because like most students, they wake up exhausted in the morning, and debate whether they want to go to school or stay home. "},{"span_id":"585:1@U009","start":1376,"end":1503,"text":"Missing a whole day of school instead of starting at the time you want could really hold you back from getting your education. "},{"span_id":"585:1@U010","start":1503,"end":1761,"text":"I have a friend who chooses to stay home instead of coming to school because he feels like once he gets to school no one helps him, but when he would take his classes online he would have all of his work done and still have time to start on the next lesson. "},{"span_id":"585:1@U011","start":1761,"end":1836,"text":"Online classes are very beneficial to students who find school difficult.
"},{"span_id":"585:1@U012","start":1836,"end":2020,"text":"
Third reason to why i believe students should require online learning as a benefit is because not every student can get the subject or class required for graduating at their school. "},{"span_id":"585:1@U013","start":2020,"end":2239,"text":"Many students shouldn't require taking all the basic classes if its not necessary, if a student is focusing on becoming an architect they should mainly take classes for that instead of classes to become something else. "},{"span_id":"585:1@U014","start":2239,"end":2325,"text":"Online classes also give students time to reflect and explore more learning options.
"},{"span_id":"585:1@U015","start":2325,"end":2521,"text":"

"},{"span_id":"1336:2@U002","start":55,"end":123,"text":"Every school should have homework club at least three times a week. "},{"span_id":"1336:2@U003","start":123,"end":235,"text":"Homework club is a club where teachers help you with your homework or if you need help understanding a subject. "},{"span_id":"1336:2@U004","start":235,"end":408,"text":"Homework club helps students get to learn a little bit more about that subject, be more active with theirs friends, and it makes them have more confidence about their work. "},{"span_id":"1336:2@U005","start":408,"end":450,"text":"Homework club is a big help for students. "},{"span_id":"1336:2@U006","start":450,"end":613,"text":"There's so many stuff you can do at homework club and that is finishing a project with a friend, studying for a test/quiz, or even finishing your homework early.
"},{"span_id":"1336:2@U007","start":613,"end":672,"text":"
At homework club you get so much help from the teachers. "},{"span_id":"1336:2@U008","start":672,"end":778,"text":"You can finish a project with a friend and when you do that it helps you be more active with that person. "},{"span_id":"1336:2@U009","start":778,"end":917,"text":"If a student ever has a doubt with a question about their project, then they can go to homework club and get some help with their project. "},{"span_id":"1336:2@U010","start":917,"end":1029,"text":"The best part about homework club is that when more students come, we get to help each other with our projects. "},{"span_id":"1336:2@U011","start":1029,"end":1103,"text":"It's like a community were we help each other with any questions we have. "},{"span_id":"1336:2@U012","start":1103,"end":1238,"text":"Projects are really hard when you do it by yourself, but if you go to homework at your school then you will get all the help you need. "},{"span_id":"1336:2@U013","start":1238,"end":1327,"text":"If your having trouble then the best place to go is homework, so you can get some help.
"},{"span_id":"1336:2@U014","start":1327,"end":1401,"text":"
Another thing you can get do at homework club is study for a test/quiz. "},{"span_id":"1336:2@U015","start":1401,"end":1507,"text":"The teachers will help you make flashcards, help you over the study guide, or even play a game of kahoot. "},{"span_id":"1336:2@U016","start":1507,"end":1604,"text":"If you didn't know what kahoot is, kahoot is a game where it helps you a lot before a test/quiz. "},{"span_id":"1336:2@U017","start":1604,"end":1670,"text":"I can say that kahoot is like a study guide but form into a game. "},{"span_id":"1336:2@U018","start":1670,"end":1803,"text":"Many students can't really study for a test/quiz when they are at home, because they can't concentrate studying when they are alone. "},{"span_id":"1336:2@U019","start":1803,"end":1919,"text":"So if you go to homework club they will help you study for your test/quiz and you will for sure not get distracted. "},{"span_id":"1336:2@U020","start":1919,"end":2079,"text":"I recommend everyone to come to homework club at least three times a week so you can get help studying for a test/quiz or if you need help with something else. "},{"span_id":"1336:2@U021","start":2079,"end":2215,"text":"If you go to homework club then you will pass your test/quiz, cause homework clubs will help you prepare yourself for your test/quiz

"},{"span_id":"1336:2@U022","start":2215,"end":2293,"text":"The last thing that homework clubs helps you is get your homework done early. "},{"span_id":"1336:2@U023","start":2293,"end":2411,"text":"the teachers will explain everything perfectly and I guarantee you will learn even more then what you learn in class. "},{"span_id":"1336:2@U024","start":2411,"end":2525,"text":"Math teachers, Science teachers, History teachers, and English teachers are going to teach students so much more. "},{"span_id":"1336:2@U025","start":2525,"end":2631,"text":"You can go to homework club and do your homework early so you don't have to worry about doing it at home. "},{"span_id":"1336:2@U026","start":2631,"end":2717,"text":"In homework club teachers explain the homework to the students but with more details. "},{"span_id":"1336:2@U027","start":2717,"end":2791,"text":"What I mean is that the teachers will teach you more about that subject.
"},{"span_id":"1336:2@U028","start":2791,"end":2841,"text":"
Homework club is one of the best club their is. "},{"span_id":"1336:2@U029","start":2841,"end":3001,"text":"It helps students learn more about the subject, it also makes them have more confidence, and it makes them be more active with your classmate at homework club. "},{"span_id":"1336:2@U030","start":3001,"end":3069,"text":"Homework club is a community full of amazing students and teachers. "},{"span_id":"1336:2@U031","start":3069,"end":3267,"text":"There's so many things teachers at homework club help you with and that is Helping you get your projects done in time, helping you study for a test/quiz, and helping you finish your homework early. "},{"span_id":"1336:2@U032","start":3267,"end":3391,"text":"We can achieve this goal of establishing homework clubs in schools, but we need help from student to make this goal happen. "},{"span_id":"1336:2@U033","start":3391,"end":3519,"text":"Homework club would be boring and not helpful if we didn't have some amazing teachers at school volunteering for homework club. "},{"span_id":"7766:2@U010","start":1104,"end":1257,"text":"Teachers can evaluate students' weaknesses and give them projects based on what they need, for their own practice and revision session during the break. "},{"span_id":"7766:2@U012","start":1388,"end":1712,"text":"For example, i already completed the earth science course on my freshmen year but, for more details and information about the topic that we discussed, our teacher gave us the project about the climate change and the impact on the environment, during the summer time, so that we can be productive and visualize in our break. "},{"span_id":"7766:2@U013","start":1712,"end":1835,"text":"Teacher-designed projects are more reliable because the teacher can choose a specific topic for the students' requirement. "},{"span_id":"7766:2@U014","start":1835,"end":1922,"text":"Some students are naive, they can't come up with a topic and they end up not doing it. "},{"span_id":"7766:2@U015","start":1922,"end":2142,"text":"Of course, many students will probably disagree on student-designed projects, and claim that teacher-designed topics are way better. However, every person has an interest on doing something or every person have a hobby. "},{"span_id":"7766:2@U016","start":2142,"end":2291,"text":"Moreover, students should be able to decide on what they desire to work on from their own interest or describe about their hobby, writing an essay.
"},{"span_id":"7766:2@U017","start":2291,"end":2385,"text":"

"},{"span_id":"7766:2@U018","start":2385,"end":2516,"text":"They should not depend on anyone else, but their heart and the way how they think, that will bring accomplishments to their lives. "},{"span_id":"7766:2@U019","start":2516,"end":2767,"text":"I understand that teachers are responsible of giving the best topics for students to work on, but i believe that, students have followed all the directions of the teacher, during the entire school-year, but in a long break, it should be the opposite. "},{"span_id":"7766:2@U021","start":2898,"end":3003,"text":"Student-designed projects will help them research about topics and, it will benefit them for the future. "},{"span_id":"7766:2@U022","start":3003,"end":3042,"text":"It will help them think independently. "},{"span_id":"7766:2@U023","start":3042,"end":3119,"text":"It will allow them to choose their desired topic and work on their own will. "},{"span_id":"7766:2@U024","start":3119,"end":3252,"text":"For example, my oceanography teacher allowed us to pick a topic from the board and he gave us an option to choose our own topic too. "},{"span_id":"7766:2@U025","start":3252,"end":3578,"text":"I managed to pick a topic that i desired, eventually, i completed my project researching and thinking about the topic on my own because i was able to elaborate it myself, since i got to choose the desired topic i want, but some of my classmates had a hard time by only researching because they chose the topic from the board. "},{"span_id":"7766:2@U026","start":3578,"end":3690,"text":"Furthermore, students can observe from their teacher and get to the point, when they can think for themselves.
"},{"span_id":"7766:2@U027","start":3690,"end":3754,"text":"

"},{"span_id":"7766:2@U028","start":3754,"end":3947,"text":"Most of the students go to trips, during summer time with their family ,and that will be great advantage for a student to come up with a self-designed project, as they visualize on their trip. "},{"span_id":"7766:2@U030","start":4032,"end":4156,"text":"Self-designed projects would be complicated for some students, but most importantly, research and your effort, is required.
