Some schools in other school districts have changed their school menu and many students and parents do not like it nor agree with it.

Students do not eat lunch now a days because they do not like the food. Some rather just go to the snack bar or vending machine we have in the cafeteria and eat snacks rather than food or bring their own lunch to school. Students bring their own food most of the time because they are used to different foods or they are allergic to certain types of foods or ingredients.

Others may say that the cafeteria food is already healthy. In the cafeteria there are many options in the four different lines. For example one line can have three main foods with different sides including fruits and vegetables. The school line also has an option between the three main foods they are serving or a salad or wrap. When the school cafeteria serves bread or any type of carbs it usually is always wheat bread which is better than any other bread.

Students who have cars or credit cards often leave school to get food or they order food online. Upperclassmen, juniors and seniors are often the ones who leave campus to get food because they have there license and have cars or they also have friends who have transportation. They usually do not come back for their last periods of the day or if they come back they come back late to class. Now with new technology and apps students order food through apps that deliver any type of food to you. Students often get in trouble by teachers and staff for it but do it anyway.

In conclusion these are some of the reasons why changing the school cafeteria lunch/menu to a healthier menu would be a bad idea. Students who do not like the school lunches already do not eat, they would leave campus and not come back or come back late. This decision would be a bad idea because some students do not eat lunch as it is, other students say that the cafeteria food is already healthy, others would leave campus or order food online. Some schools in other school districts have changed their school menu and many students and parents do not like it nor agree with it.

Students do not eat lunch now a days because they do not like the food. Some rather just go to the snack bar or vending machine we have in the cafeteria and eat snacks rather than food or bring their own lunch to school. Students bring their own food most of the time because they are used to different foods or they are allergic to certain types of foods or ingredients.

Others may say that the cafeteria food is already healthy. In the cafeteria there are many options in the four different lines. For example one line can have three main foods with different sides including fruits and vegetables. The school line also has an option between the three main foods they are serving or a salad or wrap. When the school cafeteria serves bread or any type of carbs it usually is always wheat bread which is better than any other bread.

Students who have cars or credit cards often leave school to get food or they order food online. Upperclassmen, juniors and seniors are often the ones who leave campus to get food because they have there license and have cars or they also have friends who have transportation. They usually do not come back for their last periods of the day or if they come back they come back late to class. Now with new technology and apps students order food through apps that deliver any type of food to you. Students often get in trouble by teachers and staff for it but do it anyway.

In conclusion these are some of the reasons why changing the school cafeteria lunch/menu to a healthier menu would be a bad idea. Students who do not like the school lunches already do not eat, they would leave campus and not come back or come back late. And if they change the school menu there would be more students willing to do the same thing. That's why I take the challenges on going to festivals and doing peoples makeup for five dollars. Sometimes i would be scared to mess up, but its okay because I'm working on developing my skills. Some schools even have internships that students get paid from. Some schools assign students their projects to assure, that they continue learning during their break. Most students fail to continue to learn because they have their own personal plans to accomplish during their summer break. But, some students fail to do it because the projects were given from their previous teacher, that they have already had and they do not want to work for them again. They would be more happier to design their own project for the break. The fact that they want to choose their own project is because they want to be more productive and more innovative. Although, summer projects should be student-designed.

Some people might claim that, projects should be school-based and it should be assigned by the teachers because they have the best opinions for the student to work on and they are more relevant. Teachers can evaluate students' weaknesses and give them projects based on what they need, for their own practice and revision session during the break. Teachers should assign project about the course, that they have already completed for more revision and for more details about it. For example, i already completed the earth science course on my freshmen year but, for more details and information about the topic that we discussed, our teacher gave us the project about the climate change and the impact on the environment, during the summer time, so that we can be productive and visualize in our break. Teacher-designed projects are more reliable because the teacher can choose a specific topic for the students' requirement. Some students are naive, they can't come up with a topic and they end up not doing it. Of course, many students will probably disagree on student-designed projects, and claim that teacher-designed topics are way better. However, every person has an interest on doing something or every person have a hobby. Moreover, students should be able to decide on what they desire to work on from their own interest or describe about their hobby, writing an essay.

Students should be self-reliance of themselves because self-reliance is the key to success. They should not depend on anyone else, but their heart and the way how they think, that will bring accomplishments to their lives. I understand that teachers are responsible of giving the best topics for students to work on, but i believe that, students have followed all the directions of the teacher, during the entire school-year, but in a long break, it should be the opposite. Teachers should allow students to think of their own and come up with a topic ,and write what they have learned from the teachers. Student-designed projects will help them research about topics and, it will benefit them for the future. It will help them think independently. It will allow them to choose their desired topic and work on their own will. For example, my oceanography teacher allowed us to pick a topic from the board and he gave us an option to choose our own topic too. I managed to pick a topic that i desired, eventually, i completed my project researching and thinking about the topic on my own because i was able to elaborate it myself, since i got to choose the desired topic i want, but some of my classmates had a hard time by only researching because they chose the topic from the board. Furthermore, students can observe from their teacher and get to the point, when they can think for themselves.

It is evidenced that, you can learn a lot from visualization. Most of the students go to trips, during summer time with their family ,and that will be great advantage for a student to come up with a self-designed project, as they visualize on their trip. For example, when you go to the museum, there is lot to visualize and learn from it. Self-designed projects would be complicated for some students, but most importantly, research and your effort, is required. As evidenced by the quote, "as you sow, so you reap", it means the harder you work, the better your results will be. We should always remember that, effort is valuable. Self-designed projects are very beneficial because it helps you to work as an independent individual. Furthermore, you will gain the way how you think, both physically and mentally.

In conclusion, teachers should allow students, to think for themselves' ,and allow students to choose their topics. Students-designed projects will help them think more efficiently and

it is more convenient for both students and the teacher. Visualization would be an easy hint for the student to work on their project. "},{"span_id":"7766:2@U008","start":852,"end":907,"text":"Although, summer projects should be student-designed.
"},{"span_id":"7766:2@U009","start":907,"end":1104,"text":"
Some people might claim that, projects should be school-based and it should be assigned by the teachers because they have the best opinions for the student to work on and they are more relevant. "},{"span_id":"7766:2@U010","start":1104,"end":1257,"text":"Teachers can evaluate students' weaknesses and give them projects based on what they need, for their own practice and revision session during the break. "},{"span_id":"7766:2@U011","start":1257,"end":1388,"text":"Teachers should assign project about the course, that they have already completed for more revision and for more details about it. "},{"span_id":"7766:2@U012","start":1388,"end":1712,"text":"For example, i already completed the earth science course on my freshmen year but, for more details and information about the topic that we discussed, our teacher gave us the project about the climate change and the impact on the environment, during the summer time, so that we can be productive and visualize in our break. "},{"span_id":"7766:2@U013","start":1712,"end":1835,"text":"Teacher-designed projects are more reliable because the teacher can choose a specific topic for the students' requirement. "},{"span_id":"7766:2@U014","start":1835,"end":1922,"text":"Some students are naive, they can't come up with a topic and they end up not doing it. "},{"span_id":"7766:2@U015","start":1922,"end":2142,"text":"Of course, many students will probably disagree on student-designed projects, and claim that teacher-designed topics are way better. However, every person has an interest on doing something or every person have a hobby. "},{"span_id":"7766:2@U016","start":2142,"end":2291,"text":"Moreover, students should be able to decide on what they desire to work on from their own interest or describe about their hobby, writing an essay.
"},{"span_id":"7766:2@U017","start":2291,"end":2385,"text":"
Students should be self-reliance of themselves because self-reliance is the key to success. "},{"span_id":"7766:2@U018","start":2385,"end":2516,"text":"They should not depend on anyone else, but their heart and the way how they think, that will bring accomplishments to their lives. "},{"span_id":"7766:2@U019","start":2516,"end":2767,"text":"I understand that teachers are responsible of giving the best topics for students to work on, but i believe that, students have followed all the directions of the teacher, during the entire school-year, but in a long break, it should be the opposite. "},{"span_id":"7766:2@U020","start":2767,"end":2898,"text":"Teachers should allow students to think of their own and come up with a topic ,and write what they have learned from the teachers. "},{"span_id":"7766:2@U021","start":2898,"end":3003,"text":"Student-designed projects will help them research about topics and, it will benefit them for the future. "},{"span_id":"7766:2@U022","start":3003,"end":3042,"text":"It will help them think independently. "},{"span_id":"7766:2@U023","start":3042,"end":3119,"text":"It will allow them to choose their desired topic and work on their own will. "},{"span_id":"7766:2@U024","start":3119,"end":3252,"text":"For example, my oceanography teacher allowed us to pick a topic from the board and he gave us an option to choose our own topic too. "},{"span_id":"7766:2@U025","start":3252,"end":3578,"text":"I managed to pick a topic that i desired, eventually, i completed my project researching and thinking about the topic on my own because i was able to elaborate it myself, since i got to choose the desired topic i want, but some of my classmates had a hard time by only researching because they chose the topic from the board. "},{"span_id":"7766:2@U026","start":3578,"end":3690,"text":"Furthermore, students can observe from their teacher and get to the point, when they can think for themselves.
"},{"span_id":"7766:2@U027","start":3690,"end":3754,"text":"
It is evidenced that, you can learn a lot from visualization. "},{"span_id":"7766:2@U028","start":3754,"end":3947,"text":"Most of the students go to trips, during summer time with their family ,and that will be great advantage for a student to come up with a self-designed project, as they visualize on their trip. "},{"span_id":"7766:2@U029","start":3947,"end":4032,"text":"For example, when you go to the museum, there is lot to visualize and learn from it. "},{"span_id":"7766:2@U030","start":4032,"end":4156,"text":"Self-designed projects would be complicated for some students, but most importantly, research and your effort, is required. "},{"span_id":"7766:2@U031","start":4156,"end":4273,"text":"As evidenced by the quote, "as you sow, so you reap", it means the harder you work, the better your results will be. "},{"span_id":"7766:2@U032","start":4273,"end":4325,"text":"We should always remember that, effort is valuable. "},{"span_id":"7766:2@U033","start":4325,"end":4427,"text":"Self-designed projects are very beneficial because it helps you to work as an independent individual. "},{"span_id":"7766:2@U034","start":4427,"end":4508,"text":"Furthermore, you will gain the way how you think, both physically and mentally.
"},{"span_id":"7766:2@U035","start":4508,"end":4626,"text":"
In conclusion, teachers should allow students, to think for themselves' ,and allow students to choose their topics. "},{"span_id":"7766:2@U036","start":4626,"end":4698,"text":"Students-designed projects will help them think more efficiently and

"},{"span_id":"7766:2@U037","start":4698,"end":4755,"text":"it is more convenient for both students and the teacher. "},{"span_id":"7766:2@U038","start":4755,"end":4833,"text":"Visualization would be an easy hint for the student to work on their project. "},{"span_id":"7766:2@U039","start":4833,"end":4965,"text":"For the solution, teachers should assign students to write a journal about, how they spent their time during the long summer break. "},{"span_id":"7766:2@U040","start":4965,"end":5044,"text":"Potentially, this will make it very easier for both students and the teachers. "},{"span_id":"7766:2@U041","start":5044,"end":5198,"text":"This will allow student to write about their real-life event ,and it will make the teacher very happy about reading student's personal summer experience. "}]}],"claims":[{"claim_id":"C1","scope":"target","essay_id":"2910:1","span_ids":["2910:1@U001","2910:1@U004","2910:1@U008"],"aspect":"Overall","kind":"presence","direction":"negative","feature":"組織と文法のエラーがいくつか見られる","score_relation":"評価に影響","support_explanation":"具体的なエラーが見られる","limits":"全体の頻度を断定しない"},{"claim_id":"C2","scope":"target","essay_id":"2910:1","span_ids":["2910:1@U002","2910:1@U005"],"aspect":"Cohesion","kind":"communication","direction":"negative","feature":"アイデアの接続が時折不明瞭","score_relation":"評価に影響","support_explanation":"具体的な例が見られる","limits":"全体の頻度を断定しない"},{"claim_id":"C3","scope":"target","essay_id":"2910:1","span_ids":["2910:1@U001","2910:1@U006"],"aspect":"Vocabulary","kind":"range","direction":"negative","feature":"単語の範囲が限定的","score_relation":"評価に影響","support_explanation":"具体的な例が見られる","limits":"全体の頻度を断定しない"},{"claim_id":"C4","scope":"target","essay_id":"2910:1","span_ids":["2910:1@U001","2910:1@U004"],"aspect":"Conventions","kind":"communication","direction":"negative","feature":"スペリングと文法のエラーが見られる","score_relation":"評価に影響","support_explanation":"具体的な例が見られる","limits":"全体の頻度を断定しない"}],"task":"machine span validity is separate; evaluate semantic support provisionally"}

If our school were to change the cafeteria food to healthier food selections it would be a bad idea. This decision would be a bad idea because some students do not eat lunch as it is, other students say that the cafeteria food is already healthy, others would leave campus or order food online. Some schools in other school districts have changed their school menu and many students and parents do not like it nor agree with it.

Students do not eat lunch now a days because they do not like the food. Some rather just go to the snack bar or vending machine we have in the cafeteria and eat snacks rather than food or bring their own lunch to school. Students bring their own food most of the time because they are used to different foods or they are allergic to certain types of foods or ingredients.

Others may say that the cafeteria food is already healthy. In the cafeteria there are many options in the four different lines. For example one line can have three main foods with different sides including fruits and vegetables. The school line also has an option between the three main foods they are serving or a salad or wrap. When the school cafeteria serves bread or any type of carbs it usually is always wheat bread which is better than any other bread.

Students who have cars or credit cards often leave school to get food or they order food online. Upperclassmen, juniors and seniors are often the ones who leave campus to get food because they have there license and have cars or they also have friends who have transportation. They usually do not come back for their last periods of the day or if they come back they come back late to class. Now with new technology and apps students order food through apps that deliver any type of food to you. Students often get in trouble by teachers and staff for it but do it anyway.

In conclusion these are some of the reasons why changing the school cafeteria lunch/menu to a healthier menu would be a bad idea. Students who do not like the school lunches already do not eat, they would leave campus and not come back or come back late. And if they change the school menu there would be more students willing to do the same thing. This decision would be a bad idea because some students do not eat lunch as it is, other students say that the cafeteria food is already healthy, others would leave campus or order food online. Some schools in other school districts have changed their school menu and many students and parents do not like it nor agree with it.

Students do not eat lunch now a days because they do not like the food. Some rather just go to the snack bar or vending machine we have in the cafeteria and eat snacks rather than food or bring their own lunch to school. Students bring their own food most of the time because they are used to different foods or they are allergic to certain types of foods or ingredients.

Others may say that the cafeteria food is already healthy. In the cafeteria there are many options in the four different lines. For example one line can have three main foods with different sides including fruits and vegetables. The school line also has an option between the three main foods they are serving or a salad or wrap. When the school cafeteria serves bread or any type of carbs it usually is always wheat bread which is better than any other bread.

Students who have cars or credit cards often leave school to get food or they order food online. Upperclassmen, juniors and seniors are often the ones who leave campus to get food because they have there license and have cars or they also have friends who have transportation. They usually do not come back for their last periods of the day or if they come back they come back late to class. Now with new technology and apps students order food through apps that deliver any type of food to you. Students often get in trouble by teachers and staff for it but do it anyway.

In conclusion these are some of the reasons why changing the school cafeteria lunch/menu to a healthier menu would be a bad idea. Students who do not like the school lunches already do not eat, they would leave campus and not come back or come back late. And if they change the school menu there would be more students willing to do the same thing. Most people might say it's made a positive impact on people's lives while others may disagree and say it's had a negative impact on people's lives. There may be some pros and there may be some cons to this situation. Can the impact of technology be a good or bad outcome?

Let's start off with the pros or the positive effects technology has had on people's lives, now technology has made people's lives easier. Some may say because it's easier to access what they need easier online instead of heading to the market. Some may also say it's easier and faster to call your friends or parents, any family member really, instead of driving all the way to them, which is true. Watching movies on your phone instead of going all the way to the movie theater and pay for your ticket and it only being a one time thing. There are countless positives outcomes of how technology has increased over the years. The technology nowadays makes everything faster and easier on people's lives. Unfortunately, all these great, glamorous, fast, and easy ways have some downfall to them.

Now, technology definitely has it's flaws and negative impacts on people's lives. Most can say there's not as much human interactions since technology has been brought upon people. Communication is key when interacting with one another. Today most people are also glued to their cellular device, not physically but you get the point. Especially teenagers, they have a bad habit of not being able to put down their cellphone. Whether that being during school hours, at home when you're supposed to be doing work, and maybe even at work. The generation we have today is usually all about social media, and just being on their cellphone in general 24/7. Point blank there's just no physical, verbal communication anymore between one another. It may be causing a lot of students to slack in school, and it may not only go for students and teenagers, they're not the only victims. Some particular parents may be also glued to their cellphone just as teenagers. It's not their fault nor do the teenagers have any fault in this. All this is because of the evolution of technology. It's not pleasant to live in a world with not so much communication and everyone being constantly glued to their cellphone nor is it pleasant to do awful in school because you can't put your cellular device down. Now, these are just some reasons and examples why technology has a negative impact on people's lives. Can you imagine how many more scenarios like this happen daily?

Though technology has evolved drastically through out the years and is still evolving now as we speak, there's always going going to be positive and negative impacts. Technology does help and allow people to complete tasks without having contact with others. There's the problem right there, there's no communication. Even though there are some positive effects of technology that doesn't change the fact that there are more negative effects than positive. Technology effects each person a different way, whether that being in a positive way or whether that being in a negative way. It's all a mix, and by mix I refer to positive effects and negative effects all over the place. Some people may disagree or may agree whether it's a bad mixture or a good mixture. Cell phones and all technology can make it easier or harder for certain people.

Whether if it truly is a positive or negative impact it will not change what people think or at what position they're in. Some people just like taking the easy way out and not cope with what they are losing and missing out on, communication. Human communication and interactions are not it anymore. Everyone's opinion and saying on this dilemma is different, people's mindsets are different even their actions are different from everyone else's,but this is my opinion. In conclusion, that is why I strongly, and genuinely believe technology has a negative effect on people's lives. I personally disagree with the idea of adding one and a half hours of school. The second reason why extra school hours shouldn't be added is students won't have much time for sports or other after school activities. If students get more school time they just won't stand it and they'll start skipping school. But don't worry I won't do that.

Although, summer projects should be student-designed.

Some people might claim that, projects should be school-based and it should be assigned by the teachers because they have the best opinions for the student to work on and they are more relevant. Teachers can evaluate students' weaknesses and give them projects based on what they need, for their own practice and revision session during the break. Teachers should assign project about the course, that they have already completed for more revision and for more details about it. Teacher-designed projects are more reliable because the teacher can choose a specific topic for the students' requirement. Some students are naive, they can't come up with a topic and they end up not doing it. Of course, many students will probably disagree on student-designed projects, and claim that teacher-designed topics are way better. However, every person has an interest on doing something or every person have a hobby. Moreover, students should be able to decide on what they desire to work on from their own interest or describe about their hobby, writing an essay.

Students should be self-reliance of themselves because self-reliance is the key to success. They should not depend on anyone else, but their heart and the way how they think, that will bring accomplishments to their lives. I understand that teachers are responsible of giving the best topics for students to work on, but i believe that, students have followed all the directions of the teacher, during the entire school-year, but in a long break, it should be the opposite. Teachers should allow students to think of their own and come up with a topic ,and write what they have learned from the teachers. Of course, many students will probably disagree on student-designed projects, and claim that teacher-designed topics are way better. However, every person has an interest on doing something or every person have a hobby. "},{"span_id":"1514:1@U009","start":1050,"end":1137,"text":"This shows that with hard work you can accomplish any goal and letting yourself grow.

"},{"span_id":"1514:1@U011","start":1257,"end":1392,"text":"At a young age Hitler had a dream, he wanted to study arts, he started working on it, but when he apply to college he wasn't accepted. "},{"span_id":"1514:1@U014","start":1555,"end":1644,"text":"Even though he fail the first time, he didn't give up, therefore, he became a dictator.

rubric_based_proposalは基準を満たすと宣言するだけでは不十分です。確認した特徴が条件のどの程度・頻度・伝達への影響に関わるかを説明します。Overallを主な照合先とし、分析的観点だけでOverallの段階や重みを確定しません。

この分析をfeature_confirmed、rubric_based_proposal、system_checkedへ反映します。next_action.where_span_idsには分析したspanを含め、actionは「確認」だけでなく、選んだ語やその関係を次にどう見分けるかという行動にします。現在の文を単に読み直すよう求めず、同種の判断を次の採点で再確認する具体的な着眼点にしてください。

"},{"span_id":"406:1@U006","start":558,"end":583,"text":"I had myself and my son. "},{"span_id":"406:1@U007","start":583,"end":715,"text":"I took that as my motivation, yes it was difficult especially after I delivered and going back to school because I was very behind. "},{"span_id":"406:1@U008","start":715,"end":820,"text":"Of course a lot of friends stopped talking to me but that just proves who's there for you and who's not. "},{"span_id":"406:1@U009","start":820,"end":1010,"text":"I was starting a new chapter in my life and I'm not saying having my son was a mistake but it was just at the wrong time; cant change the past though, you just have to keep moving forward.\r\n"},{"span_id":"406:1@U010","start":1010,"end":1388,"text":"\r\nHere I am now my senior year, eight more months until I graduate and I'm proud of myself because I am a mother now and I'm still going to school, I didnt let that stop me from getting my education and I'm planning to go to college too because all I want is the best for my son and myself; its not me I have to think about now, I have another responsibility to look after for. "},{"span_id":"406:1@U011","start":1388,"end":1547,"text":"There are many examples of failing in life and later on succeeding but this is one I went through, I had to grow up fast but it made me the person I am today. "},{"span_id":"406:1@U012","start":1547,"end":1670,"text":"Just because of one mistake you make in life doesnt mean your life is over, its probably just the beginning, we are human! "},{"span_id":"406:1@U013","start":1670,"end":1774,"text":"We all make mistakes but you just have to keep moving forward because life goes on with or without you. "},{"span_id":"318:2@U013","start":1015,"end":1097,"text":"A real example is when you have a buiness and you are not earning enough money

"},{"span_id":"318:2@U014","start":1097,"end":1124,"text":"and then you break, and

"},{"span_id":"318:2@U015","start":1124,"end":1200,"text":"you do not have the enthusiasm to do or to find other way to do it better.
"},{"span_id":"318:2@U016","start":1200,"end":1333,"text":"
In a company many people used to loss the enthusiasm, and that is okay because we are here do do mistakes and do not be perfects.
"},{"span_id":"318:2@U017","start":1333,"end":1370,"text":"
secondly, failure is not always

"},{"span_id":"318:2@U018","start":1370,"end":1438,"text":"bad because by doing mistake we can learn how to do our job better. "},{"span_id":"318:2@U019","start":1438,"end":1560,"text":"for example, when I am working hard and then something is wrong, but my manager says that I can do it, he is motiving me. "},{"span_id":"318:2@U020","start":1560,"end":1614,"text":"That is a good reason that I can be more enthuasiasm. "},{"span_id":"318:2@U021","start":1614,"end":1684,"text":"But do not be enthuasiam just for money, because many people do that. "},{"span_id":"318:2@U022","start":1684,"end":1839,"text":"when we have enough enthusiasm and be positive for every single day, then you can do great things in this life by doing mistakes and failing in every job. "},{"span_id":"318:2@U023","start":1839,"end":1907,"text":"So, failure could be one of the best way to learn and keep doing

"},{"span_id":"318:2@U024","start":1907,"end":1924,"text":"your job better. "},{"span_id":"318:2@U025","start":1924,"end":1993,"text":"I like this reason because I know that to be enthusiasm is not easy. "},{"span_id":"318:2@U026","start":1993,"end":2067,"text":"I have been doing mistakes in my job, Also sometimes I though to give up. "},{"span_id":"318:2@U027","start":2067,"end":2129,"text":"In addition, that was just a though, nothing wrong with that. "},{"span_id":"318:2@U028","start":2129,"end":2245,"text":"It is sad when we see peope giving up and we just want to help, but we cannot because these peope do not want help. "},{"span_id":"318:2@U029","start":2245,"end":2379,"text":"Most people that decided to give up and then they lost they job and the enthusiasm they just do not want to do anything to be better. "},{"span_id":"318:2@U030","start":2379,"end":2458,"text":"I mean that the failure in some people is badand the most of the people good.
"},{"span_id":"318:2@U031","start":2458,"end":2520,"text":"
The third reason that I would like to talk about is that

"},{"span_id":"318:2@U032","start":2520,"end":2599,"text":"we have enthusiasm we can do and be better in this life, work or any buisness. "},{"span_id":"318:2@U033","start":2599,"end":2694,"text":"It does not matter if we fail, but if we have the enthusiasm we can do wharever we want to do. "},{"span_id":"318:2@U034","start":2694,"end":2793,"text":"For example, when I was 11, my that always excites me when I was in school, and to do my homework. "},{"span_id":"318:2@U035","start":2793,"end":2847,"text":"But now that I am an adult this is more diffilcult

"},{"span_id":"318:2@U036","start":2847,"end":2865,"text":"to decide what

"},{"span_id":"318:2@U037","start":2865,"end":2928,"text":"career stady.I will never forget what my dad used to teach me. "},{"span_id":"318:2@U038","start":2928,"end":2996,"text":"I never loss the enthusiasm, sometime I fail and then I stand up

"},{"span_id":"318:2@U039","start":2996,"end":3027,"text":"with the same way that I fall. "},{"span_id":"318:2@U040","start":3027,"end":3127,"text":"Also, if you fail and then your life changes toltaly and you pass to be a coworker to be a manager. "},{"span_id":"318:2@U041","start":3127,"end":3143,"text":"That is great.
"},{"span_id":"318:2@U042","start":3143,"end":3204,"text":"
Becase you did mistakes and then you had the enthusiasm

"},{"span_id":"318:2@U043","start":3204,"end":3228,"text":"to be a better person.
"},{"span_id":"318:2@U044","start":3228,"end":3338,"text":"
In a company if there is the enthusiasm and the company wants to be the most importan company in this word. "},{"span_id":"318:2@U045","start":3338,"end":3440,"text":"This mean that the enthusiasm is good for everybody that who wants to be positive and a good person.
"},{"span_id":"318:2@U046","start":3440,"end":3555,"text":"
I conclution, these reason that I am so agree with Churchill's statement, we can do things better if we want to. "},{"span_id":"318:2@U047","start":3555,"end":3588,"text":"That is why I am agree with him. "},{"span_id":"318:2@U048","start":3588,"end":3638,"text":"None is perfect in this life, job or buisness,

"},{"span_id":"318:2@U049","start":3638,"end":3689,"text":"we can make mistakes and learn about our mistakes. "},{"span_id":"318:2@U050","start":3689,"end":3784,"text":"Just be positive and do your job easy by failure to failure, but never lossing the enthusiasm. "},{"span_id":"318:2@U051","start":3784,"end":3875,"text":"I will be always positive in this life by fuilure to failure but never loss my enthusiasm.
